scope: Exploratory post-hoc Setx age-by-genotype analysis; conditional library-level inference, not a confirmatory biological discovery family. Earlier age-specific patterns were already inspected.
model: Ten categorical age-by-genotype cell means; contrast each later KO-Control difference against P10; joint four-df moderated F.
expression_filter: TPM >= 1 in at least min(4,n_cell) libraries of any one cell, before candidate selection, repeated after omissions.
multiplicity: BY over all expressed original gene IDs for the single omnibus F per gene, separately per variant; BH sensitivity. Variant intersections are descriptive, not a new calibrated family.
source_code_note: 7844 is a filename token of unconfirmed meaning, not a confirmed animal ID. Do not relabel or infer pairing.
omissions: All 40 single-library omissions at pseudocount 0.5; effects only, missing genes fail descriptive retention.
candidate_rule: Fixed earlier 105 candidates / 36 stable downward priorities; uniquely mapped symbols only; no candidate-only testing or adjustment.
effect_screen: P18-P10 difference of KO-Control log2(TPM+pseudocount) means <= -log2(1.5), descriptive only.
technical_note: Audit barcode nesting and rank; no barcode-adjusted genotype/age claim when design is aliased. Barcode tokens are not established batches.
independence: Animals, pooling, and cross-age independence unconfirmed. No inferred pairing from expression.
primary_replication: Existing four-unit directional analysis remains unchanged; Setx is not a new vote.
